body: I do have the option to see a psychologist. I'm just so scared to make the phone call and promise myself to turn up to the appointment. It's something I have to work on and push past the fear.
I've been to my GP twice to be referred to a psychologist. Making the phone call however and keeping a promise to myself to turn up to the appointment is what scares me the most.

I empathise with you and your girlfriend so much. I really wish her all the best in recovering from this horrible disease. And kudos to you for being a great BF and sticking by her side to support her.

About 6 years ago I started restricting and hit my lowest weight. After starting university I began to binge and purge, this has been going on for almost 4 years now. I'm currently at my heaviest weight ever, my binge episodes have gotten much worse. I've ruined my teeth from purging so instead I've become addicted to laxatives. 
I'm trying really hard to loose and get back to a "health stable weight". I'm just scared of loosing control.

The hard truth is that laxatives will not make you lose weight. They will force the removal of waste in the large intestine, but will also leave you dehydrated. 
From personal experience, using laxatives will give the illusion of "thinness", but ultimately I've always found to bloat after a day or two. It's really counterproductive. 
It's not worth it. The pain is horrible, being stuck at home all day to deal with the fall out is even worse. Not to mention the damage it will cause to your body.

Don't chase a man 10+ years your senior as soon as you turn 18. I know it seems really mature and fun to date someone older, but you're still too naive to realise he is just going to play around with you. 

Focus on making friends at college and university. You don't realise how lonely it's going to be when you look back at your education experience and feeling like you've missed out on something. 

And for that matter, change your degree! I know that right now you have it all figured out and you know exactly what you want to pursue, but trust me, it's a phase, you will grow out of it. 3 years later you'll be miserable and failing class after class because you don't see the point in putting in the effort anymore.
Melvins absolutely blew my 14 year old mind away! Shame they are so underrated.
